name: Away
description: Locks the Mac when your phone leaves

config.label: Phone
config.help: Your phone, from the paired devices Away can hear nearby. It has to be paired with this Mac in System Settings → Bluetooth.

config.label: Idle for
config.help: How long the Mac must go untouched before you can count as away.

config.label: Phone silent for
config.help: How long the phone must go unheard before you can count as away. A phone lying idle on a desk was measured going 75 s between signals, so nothing shorter than 90 s is offered.
